name: Against Malaria Foundation
mission: We help protect people from malaria We fund longlasting insecticidal nets LLINs and work with distribution partners to ensure they are used We track and report on net use and impact
theoryOfChange: The Against Malaria Foundation (AMF) outlines its strategic approach under its 'Guiding principles' section on its official website. This framework emphasizes impact, accountability, efficiency, and transparency. AMF states that 'Having and demonstrating impact is central to what we do. We quantify and report on net usage and malaria levels.' Their approach involves funding and distributing long-lasting insecticidal nets (LLINs), monitoring net use through surveys, and tracking malaria case data to assess their effectiveness in preventing malaria and saving lives.
